run_spm_decode_pieces: run a sentencepiece model to decode piece tokens from an input file into text
run_spm_decode_ids: run a sentencepiece model to decode integer IDs from an input file into text
run_spm_decode_unk_remapping: run a sentencepiece decoder that remaps <<unk>> tokens to ID 0 before decoding
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and decodes sentencepiece tokens line by line
summarize_spm_decode: summarize the sentencepiece decoding script that supports piece and ID input formats
